Option labels, radii, squared-distance constants, and instruction ownership
were recovered from Hueponik's unified PAL patch at commit
`ac46a5dc500a9581ea55b8efb5c1a0d4be944aba`.

This package contains no patch bytes, replacement executable, guest code
engine, high-RAM data, or menu detour. It models the chosen instruction
semantics at authenticated stock sites and stores the choice in host config.
